recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core source work is needed unless the work group later decides to reintroduce a human-readable BackboneElement specialization list or the existing backbone-elements.json generation/link becomes stale.
issue_request: FHIR-16074 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core issue about the old BackboneElement Specializations section. It asked what the gray-background grouping in the table meant and whether the rendered table should instead be called a list; the approved resolution said the grouping was resources and to call it a list unless it got deleted.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-16074 was found. The Jira comments say the section "has been deleted," and git-svn commit 80af10ced20a8c7a2ead7470a7d0adc81212d56c for the tightly related GF#17015 removed source/backboneelement.html's Specializations heading, explanatory prose, and <%backboneelementlist%> macro, while preserving the data as generated backbone-elements.json.
additional_context: FHIR-17015 and FHIR-17016 are the same old BackboneElement Specializations table family and are already represented on the combined branch, so they were not republished here. Later refactoring moved BackboneElement from the obsolete standalone page into source/types.html; source/fhir.ini maps backboneelement to the Type Framework page, source/types.html explains implicit BackboneElement descendants without a specialization table, and source/downloads.html still links code generators to backbone-elements.json.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The condition in the FHIR-16074 resolution was met by deleting the rendered table/list rather than renaming it, and current source/build outputs do not contain a stale public BackboneElement specialization table needing clarification.
